title: Visakhapatnam police arrest six in Bengaluru over ₹1.94 crore 'digital arrest' fraud on retired man
date_note: Deccan Chronicle (published 22 November) says the six arrests were made on November 20; the fraud date is not given.
geo_basis: victim's city stated by source (Visakhapatnam); arrests made in Bengaluru
summary: Deccan Chronicle reports that a retired employee in Visakhapatnam transferred ₹1.94 crore in 13 instalments to various bank accounts after callers posing as CBI, RBI and police officials threatened him with 'digital arrest'. On November 20 a Visakhapatnam police team arrested six suspects in Bengaluru, after three earlier arrests. Police are continuing their inquiry into overseas links and the role of other members.
plain: Deccan Chronicle reports a retired man in Visakhapatnam sent ₹1.94 crore in 13 instalments to scammers posing as officials. Police arrested six more suspects in Bengaluru on November 20, after three earlier arrests.
exec: Police arrested six more suspects in Bengaluru over a 'digital arrest' scam that took ₹1.94 crore from one victim, per Deccan Chronicle.
